text:
zoe: Quick thread: drafting a tiny Optimize Toolkit FAQ about micro-batching + kv prefetch for quantized models. Need two micro snippets (Python + Go) and a one-line migration note. Keeping everything short.

ben: I can review. Avoid hard-coding model names and keep snippets <10 lines.

mohit: I'll test the Go snippet against a q4 build later. Note: confirm anchor for quant docs (I think #quantization-guidance).

zoe: Draft Python snippet (very small):
```py
# pseudocode - redwood python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = c.generate({"model":"<model-name>","max_tokens":48,"batching":{"type":"micro","max_batch_tokens":256},"kv_prefetch":false})
print(resp.text)
```

ben: Good. For long-batch workloads add a one-liner recommending kv_prefetch=true.

mohit: Go snippet draft (short):
```go
// pseudocode - redwood-go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req := redwood.GenerationRequest{Model:"<model-name>", MaxTokens:48, Batching:redwood.Micro{MaxBatchTokens:256}, KVPrefetch:false}
resp, _ := client.Generate(req)
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

zoe: Migration blurb to add: "Older examples defaulted to kv-prefetch on; with quant kernels that can increase peak RAM. Explicitly set kv_prefetch and benchmark on representative workloads."

docs-bot: Reminder: add samplegen metadata (opt/microbatch-quant) and run code-block lint per CONTRIBUTING.md.

ben: I'll do a quick lint pass and check anchors tomorrow.
